title: A marketplace for short-term studio hire
thesis: Studios sit empty and creators need space, so a marketplace should work.
note: Interest is visibly declining and two attempts have already failed.

evidence.title: Two prior marketplaces closed
evidence.body: Both attempts closed within two years, citing the cost of acquiring both sides.

evidence.title: Studio owner describes direct booking
evidence.body: Our regulars book by text. We tried a marketplace and it brought people who never came back.

evidence.title: Search interest falling
evidence.body: Interest in studio hire has fallen steadily over three years.
